description: Filter and sort ALL MFM company profiles (about 10,700 listed companies) by the parameters the USER chooses, using the latest fiscal year of each profile. Returns at most 30 companies with only the requested parameters, the audit level, a link and the exact fetch_id of the complete page. The order is the one chosen by the user: it is a data selection, not a recommendation, rating or investment advice; say so to the user. Ratios marked [fraction] are decimals (0.15 = 15%) both in filters and in results. Missing values never pass a filter or a sort. Quota per MFM account: 20 selections a day and 200 a month; complete pages read afterwards with fetch count toward 10 every 5 minutes, 40 a day and 100 different companies a month (for more, contact the Observatory). Metrics: anni_in_utile_5: Profitable years in the last 5; anni_oe_debito: Years of owner earnings to repay debt; anni_oe_debito_imp: Years of owner earnings to repay debt + commitments; anni_utile_debito: Years of earnings to repay debt;
